newsitem.title: USA: HL&P South Texas nuke boosts power output.
newsitem.headline: HL&P South Texas nuke boosts power output.

text.p: Houston Lighting & Power Co's (HL&P) 1,250 megawatt South Texas nuclear unit 2 was boosting power output early Thursday after returning from a maintenance outage, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit was operating at 58 percent of capacity and was "increasing power," the NRC said in its daily plant status report for Thursday.
South Texas 2 was shut Feb 8 for scheduled refueling and maintenance.
The adjoining 1,250 megawatt South Texas nuclear unit 1 was operating at full capacity as of early Thursday, the NRC said.
Houston Lighting & Power is a subsidiary of Houston Industries Inc.
